display_name: 十类浅层参考与六源 KL 参考改进探索
description: 十类 8 行与六源 12 行；固定 U 权重、损失因子与梯度规则，E20 各自续训 E50。
authorization: 2026-11-17 用户要求按十类浅层、六源KL方向直接发布改进实验；clean only。

code.commit: actual committed release identity in runtime.json

data.dataset: original ten-class ManyRx and six-source receiver contracts

roles.U_s: TX blind in training; offline diagnostic only after E50

data.support_query_ref: fixed clean cross-date, cross-RX and double-cross; prediction before independent scoring
data.leo_config_ref: not applicable: clean-only, no new satellite observations

permissions.query_use: frozen raw clean prediction; independent truth-last scoring
permissions.claim_scope: seed selected by previously exposed clean target; exploratory, not an independent blind evaluation

checkpoint.initialization: matching original same-setting source-only Tri E20 then own E21–E50
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: same source roles, physical IDs, seed and original source-only E20, no target-trained checkpoint
checkpoint.selection_rule: all fixed rows E50; candidate design uses previously exposed clean, so exploration only

execution.gpu_policy: GPU 1,3,5,7; all owners/pending <=5 per GPU; >=12 GiB free; one own worker per GPU
execution.launch_command: python -m experiments.pamf_repl_priority.publish --repo REPO --output OUTPUT --context CONTEXT --ssh-config CONFIG
execution.stop_rule: On protocol, nonfinite or launch failure stop new dispatch; preserve all outputs and healthy workers; no low-score stops.

expected_artifacts: 20 E30/E50 source trajectories with every-step gradients and sampled actual AdamW reference updates
20 blind U observation files and frozen independent U correctness diagnostics
20 raw clean predictions and independent truth-last scores

metric_names: U acceptance, unique coverage and post-freeze correctness
group raw and applied gradients, reference conflicts and caps
every-100-step actual joint and same-state reference-only AdamW direction

notes: Design is based on exposed target clean and chosen seed; all results are exploratory.
Ten-class reference is actual U shallow contrast, while raw control has no L-anchored native U guard.
Six-source exact ordinary/mixed/raw U KL graph supplies reference; As KL remains 0; native-guard controls remain.
Reference control projects and caps remainder at 0.5 reference norm; zero-reference falls back to raw joint gradient.
No guarantee of AdamW update alignment; record every-100-step actual update versus same-state reference-only update.
Blind U truth only scored independently after freeze; never used by training or model selection.
Every candidate has fixed E50 and frozen clean prediction followed by truth-last independent scoring; no satellite.
